morgan: RFC follow-up — we need a pragmatic checklist for decomposing the session KV + eviction behavior. main concern is cross-service latency on the hotpath and correctness around leases/evictions.
kevin: agree. proposal: runtime keeps ephemeral cache + lease token; session-store is source of truth. interface idea: GetSession(id) -> {lease, metadata} and RenewLease(token). keep sync reads <2ms for hot keys. do we accept async for cold keys?
sara: prefer synchronous for hot prefixes. for cold keys we can return a streaming fallback: first return cached metadata, then stream durable payload when available. also: enforce opaque lease token so runtime cannot mutate durable state.
jonathan: ownership note — session-store owns durability and eviction policy; runtime owns local cache and lease lifecycle. migration path: feature-flagged canary on Dedicated, then broad rollout. rollback = flip flag + let caches warm down.
ana: (typo)
ana: sorry, meant ana: telemetry requirements: add evict_fallback_rate, fallback_p95_lat, lease_renew_failures. create dashboards and an alert when fallback_rate > 1% sustained.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for branch runtime/session-evict-v2 on eng-runtime cluster. https://ci.internal/redwood/build/8921 :rocket:
morgan: good list. here's the checklist I sketched: 
- define minimal contract (GetSession, RenewLease, ReleaseLease) + error semantics
- runtime cache semantics (TTL, soft-evict, prefetch of hot prefixes)
- migration plan (canary -> ramp -> abort gate)
- metrics + alerts (ana's list)
- chaos test / load harness for cold-miss scenario
- abort criteria + rollback steps
kevin: add one more: coordinated eviction during scale events to avoid global stampede. implement splay + token-bucket backoff for RenewLease storms.
sara: and add perf test: 100k qps, 5% cold misses, ensure fallback p95 < 10ms and overall 99p latency goal met. if not, block rollout.
jonathan: can we summarize as 4 guardrails for the RFC addendum? 1) latency SLOs for hot path, 2) ownership and bounded write surface, 3) observability + abort gates, 4) migration canary with automatic rollback conditions.
morgan: love it. I'll draft the RFC addendum and the checklist PR. @kevin @sara please review by EOD Friday — if no major objections we'll schedule the canary next week. :thumbsup:
